title: An input-output approach for giant atom scatterings beyond the dipole approximation
summary: A giant atom is an artificial matter configuration whose spatial scale is comparable to the wavelength of the interacting electromagnetic wave, such that the usual electric-dipole approximation is no longer valid. As a consequence, certain quasi-direct scattering channels for the electromagnetic wave can arise.
